shapeSummary: Cylindrical 25D-style gearmotor with its axis along X, centered at X=0 and Z=0, and lying on Y=0 (axis at Y=12.5). It is built from a 24.4 mm diameter motor can and gearbox, 54 mm long in total, plus a 4 mm D-shaft extending 12.5 mm from the face plate (tip at X=33.25). Two 3 mm blind mounting holes, 4 mm deep, sit at Z=±8 on the face plate.
warnings: Body length, can/gearbox split, and body diameter (24.4 mm) are visual estimates; no drawing dimensions were given.
Mounting hole diameter, positions and depth are estimated; the face plate probably has more holes, whose layout is not clear.
The encoder disc/cap and the wire harness with its connector are visible in the image but are omitted.
The brass bushing ring at the shaft base, the gearbox screw heads and the D-flat size are not modeled precisely; the flat is approximated at 1.5 mm from the axis.
The motor rear end cap and terminals are omitted.
cadquery:
r = 12.2
cy = 12.5
motor = cq.Workplane('YZ', origin=(-33.25, cy, 0)).circle(r).extrude(33.0)
gear = cq.Workplane('YZ', origin=(-0.25, cy, 0)).circle(r).extrude(21.0)
shaft = cq.Workplane('YZ', origin=(20.75, cy, 0)).circle(2.0).extrude(12.5)
flat_cut = cq.Workplane('XY').box(10, 4, 2, centered=(False, True, False)).translate((23.25, cy, 1.5))
shaft = shaft.cut(flat_cut)
holes = cq.Workplane('YZ', origin=(16.75, cy, 0)).pushPoints([(0, 8), (0, -8)]).circle(1.5).extrude(4.0)
part = motor.union(gear).union(shaft).cut(holes)
